Declare Atom.Updated At

## Summary

Declare Projection.Updated At

## Claim

```CFEL
Projection.Updated At{:1}: [datetime]{:1};
Projection.Updated At.*[]{:0}
```

Updated At identifies the latest completed rebuild represented by the Projection.

cases.scenario: input Atom A@1 -> output Atom B@1
cases.expected: Capture each side identity separately; match updated-at events on output identity, never input.

cases.scenario: accepted promotion modifies Version and Status
cases.expected: One update event; include changed business properties; match output Atom ID and Version.

cases.scenario: accepted Atom create has output A@1 and no input
cases.expected: Valid absent input; timestamp includes accepted create for output.

cases.scenario: accepted Projection create or rebuild includes output P with ID and Updated At
cases.expected: Require no Projection Version and use Projection ID for output binding.

cases.scenario: Atom A@1 and A@2 have independent accepted event histories
cases.expected: Each Atom version uses event matching its output ID and Version.

cases.scenario: event happened at 09:00 inserted after another happened at 10:00
cases.expected: Use happened_at maximum, not insertion time; late insertion does not itself advance Updated At.

cases.scenario: no-op, failed, archive alone, or carrier-only move
cases.expected: No matching accepted business create/update event; Updated At remains unchanged.
One update Event Record, without Atom.Content or descendants in record.

cases.scenario: Event has no output or output for another object
cases.expected: Exclude from target MAX without evaluating missing output fields.

cases.scenario: Event declares matching output but a required field or timestamp is malformed
cases.expected: Evaluation error rather than treating invalid present value as absence.

cases.scenario: Event author Actor performed event; action names accepted business operation
cases.expected: Resolve canonical HAS_EVENT_AUTHOR; action is required string with admitted cases, not a closed domain.

cases.scenario: An accepted Atom or Projection update Event Record has an output but no input descriptor.
cases.expected: Invalid: the applicable capture Rule requires object_input for updates independently of the MAX query; creation input remains optional.
